Questions

Good questions.
Straight answers.

How long does a brand identity project take?

A focused identity typically takes 6–10 weeks. A full strategy, naming and identity programme usually runs 10–16 weeks, depending on research and stakeholder reviews.

Do you work on rebrands as well as new brands?

Yes. Rebrands start with an audit of what equity is worth keeping, so the new brand moves forward without throwing away recognition you have already earned.

What do we receive at the end?

A brand platform, the full identity system in production-ready formats, and guidelines your team and partners can actually use.
